name: Adelina Trisha
source:
She is the daughter of the chief of the Trisha tribe, a dark elf tribe that rules over the Everdark Forest.

She is the only one in her tribe with black hair, and is said to be strongly protected by the dark god, so she excels in dark magic rather than martial arts.

She is unusually quiet and calm among the hot-tempered dark elves, but she harbors a fire inside her.


[Translated from [url=https://www.turumiku.jp/product/gouhou/#character03]the official site[/url]]
